digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 (overlay prior-art), web search grounding tool routing
propositions: Criterion T1 (blocking, facet: overlay-priorart) declares web:true in routing registry but is silently stripped when routed through Bedrock because the web-search tool attachment checks resolved.startswith('anthropic'), which fails for 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'

The prefix-matching gate in _anthropic_web_search_capabilities violates the epic's zero-exceptions rule that provider qualification must derive from registry membership, not name shape, and this violation was masked until the Bedrock cutover made it bite

T1's verdict provenance records native_structured_output and other capabilities but omits any record that web search was withheld, so the silent degradation cannot be detected post-hoc in a signed verdict

T1 must have web access on every provider rebar can route it to (including Bedrock), which requires either measuring whether Bedrock's Converse API carries the native server-side tool or implementing a rebar-side mechanism with bounded egress/caching/prompt-injection tradeoffs

The web-search capability decision must be moved from anthropic_model.py (provider-specific detail) to capabilities.py and must take no model or provider input, deriving only from profile registry membership so it cannot gate on a name shape
T1's rubric must be updated to assert web access is guaranteed rather than optional/provider-dependent, while retaining and strengthening the clause forbidding fabricated citations
